label: A claimed amino-acid change is impossible below the code distance
statement_en: With the standard genetic code as a 64-codon table and minSubst a b the least number of positions in which a codon for a and a codon for b differ, no codon pair turns a into b in fewer than minSubst a b nucleotide substitutions. A claim of n substitutions with n < minSubst a b is therefore impossible. minSubst is computed over the table, so the kernel evaluates each instance: Phe to Leu takes 1, Trp to Stop 1, Met to Trp 2.

hypotheses.name: genotype-genetic-code#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: The standard genetic code. Mitochondrial and variant codes differ; selenocysteine insertion and RNA editing are outside the table.

hypotheses.name: genotype-genetic-code#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: One codon per position, substitutions within that codon; frameshifts, indels and multi-codon changes are not modelled.

hypotheses.name: genotype-genetic-code#assumed-3
hypotheses.statement: That reachability in the code is only reachability: nothing here says a substitution occurred, was favoured, or had the claimed effect.
